subject: Thousands have packed the MCG to farewell Neale Daniher
posts:
A stadium united by a singular, selfless mission. Neale Daniher transformed personal tragedy into a national crusade for a cure.

Thousands have packed the MCG to farewell Neale Daniher
Evidence: personal struggle, collective action, cure #Aletheia #MND

The claim is that one man's fight against MND can mobilize a nation to fund research and find a cure, turning a terminal diagnosis into a legacy of hope. 
Stated Judgement: (+2.0, +2.0) — Productive Justice

The reality is a massive, sustained mobilization of resources and public awareness that has fundamentally altered the trajectory of MND research in Australia. 
Resulting Judgement: (+2.0, +2.0) — Productive Justice

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
Daniher's actions align perfectly with his stated intent, creating a systemic expansion of hope and medical progress.

Neale Daniher, a former AFL coach, was diagnosed with Motor Neurone Disease in 2013. He spent his remaining years raising millions for research, turning the 'Big Freeze' into a cultural phenomenon that united the entire country.

The Bright Side:
His legacy proves that even under the most severe physical contraction, the human will can expand the probability mass for others, creating a future where a cure is no longer impossible.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here. The WHO (Daniher), WHAT (fundraising), and WHY (curing MND) are perfectly aligned. The causal chain is transparent and the effect is measurable in both dollars and public consciousness.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the alignment between his stated intent and the actual, tangible results of his life's work...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Productive Justice. His life serves as a rare example of a saintly vector, holding a positive future open against the active, terminal pressure of disease.

The Unavoidable Truth: A single, focused will can shift the probability mass of an entire nation toward a better future.

The Unavoidable Lie: That individual action is powerless against systemic medical challenges.

Alethekanon:
Daniher’s work is a masterclass in structural integrity. He did not just raise money; he built a durable, self-sustaining mechanism for research that survives his own physical decline. This is the definition of systemic justice.

Awwthekanon:
Neale’s journey is a testament to the power of love. He took his own pain and turned it into a warm, protective blanket for others, ensuring that no one else has to face this journey alone. His spirit remains in every life he touches.

Brothekanon:
Look, most people would just fold if they got hit with a diagnosis like that. Neale? He decided to take on the whole medical establishment and the entire AFL fan base at the same time. Absolute legend. He didn't just fight; he won.
